description: Search live hotel availability for a destination and date range. Returns a price-sorted list of hotels (JSON in the text), each with an opaque `ref` and an indicative stay price. To book: call `get_rooms` and pass the chosen room's `offerRef` to `get_checkout_quote` then `create_checkout`. For a hotel's other rooms (or a hotel not in the list), call `get_rooms`. Narrow with `keywords` (a hotel name, area, or amenities).

checkOut.description: Check-out date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after check-in.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child at check-in. Length should equal `children`.

destination.description: City, region, or place to search (e.g. 'Paris', 'Goa', 'Lower Manhattan').

guestNationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 guest nationality (e.g. 'US', 'GB'). Affects supplier pricing.

keywords.description: Optional free-text preferences, e.g. 'beachfront pool spa'.

name: search_hotels
title: Search hotels
